knownLimitations: Runtime implements deterministic character-creation increments through classification, Metis deformity, initial Gifts, Attribute priority/allocation, Ability priority/allocation, Background allocation, resources, Rank, identity name, and completion validation.
Character creation completion validation is executable for the approved current slice; completion does not perform Chronicle-owned persistence or activation.
Optional identity fields, Renown, and post-creation runtime remain unimplemented.
Package is not promoted, published, installed, enabled, active, or Campaign-bound.
Final PackageId remains a governance decision; packageId value is provisional.
Frenzy runtime mechanics are partially executable: test definition, enter/suppress/end operations, and Besta Interior dice penalty are implemented. Gift/Rite/Spirit interactions are deferred.
